title: Deadwood Solo Open - Last Night
description: Survive ten timed solo waves in your browser with Last Night, a five-minute stand until dawn. Enemies scatter between waves, with health and ammunition refilled; the original twenty-wave campaign and practice remain available. Automatically produced by LOB7 Enhancement.
controls: Keyboard and mouse or an Xbox-compatible gamepad.
WASD/ZQSD or arrows: move; mouse: look; left click: fire.
Shift: run; C: crouch; Space: jump; R: reload.
1–4 or wheel: weapons; E: interact; V: drop weapon.
G: grenade; B: umbrella; N: next wave.
Choose Classic (20 waves) or Last Night (ten 25-second survival waves) before starting.
Esc or P: pause; Last Night has no mid-run saves. Classic saves remain available.
